dedupe_keys.name: clean technology capital and levelized cost projections

description: The clean-technology cost team publishes investment and levelized-cost projections for solar, wind, stationary batteries and hydrogen electrolysers. Its July 2025 version 2.0 Zenodo release contains a spreadsheet database, a coding-oriented workbook and MATLAB files for the paper's figures. The own description lists utility and rooftop photovoltaics, concentrated solar thermal, onshore and offshore wind, lithium-ion storage, alkaline and PEM electrolysers. Public access is free under CC BY 4.0. The tables can supply cost assumptions and uncertainty ranges in capacity-expansion simulations, including studies using model-pypsa-eur. A caveat is that projections from different studies, currencies and base years must be normalized before comparison. A forecast is not a current vendor quote or site-specific project price. The own repository metadata and file list were inspected, but spreadsheet values, conversion formulas and chart scripts were not opened or run.
